//layering: CITADEL0002/0003: concentric ring architecture. A project may use symbols only from the universal kernel (rank == universalRank) or the layer exactly one rank inward (strict adjacency). Composition roots wire all layers and are exempt. Any unranked GameServer.* project is an error.
//invariants: CITADEL0004-0013: architectural invariants DERIVED FROM docs/manifest/surface-manifest.json (invariantEvidence). Each rule keys off the symbols the surface trace observed. Symbol identities below mirror the analyzer defaults (single source of truth lives in InvariantConfig); the tuning knobs (assemblies, allowlists, exempt types, requiredTagsByMetric) are what ops adjust.

invariants.//0004: Simulation purity: no wall-clock / ambient randomness in the kernel assembly.
invariants.//0005: Protocol payloads are immutable sealed records.
invariants.//0006: Realtime/routing buffers must be bounded; allowlist the in-process test transport.
invariants.//0007: Room identity carries tenant context; exempt the IPC room proxy (tracked manifest gap ipc-no-tenant-tag).
invariants.//0008: Protocol dispatch must have a default arm.
invariants.//0009: Room state mutated only by the owner type.
invariants.//0010: Telemetry context tags. requiredTagsByMetric is intentionally EMPTY (rule dormant): the trace found untagged hot-path metrics (gap obs-untagged-hotpath); populate 'Metric=tagA,tagB' entries here as those gaps are closed.
